Sure! If you’re on a Windows machine, you can quickly see the current time from the Command Prompt with:

```cmd
echo %time%
```

That will print something like:

```
14:23:07.45
```

If you want the full date and time, you can use PowerShell instead:

```powershell
Get-Date
```

Which will output something like:

```
Friday, May 31, 2026 2:23:07 PM
```
